verdict.rationale: Bruno ships a built-in assistant, Bruno AI, documented in first-party docs. It offers an AI Chat Sidebar available anywhere in the workspace, AI-icon generation of pre/post scripts, tests and docs for review and acceptance, ghost-text suggestions, and generation of complete Apps from request or collection context. It runs on bring-your-own-key and OpenAI-compatible providers, with org governance on Ultimate. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant, evidence of autonomous multi-step task execution beyond generate-and-accept outputs.
